Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

  • Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

  • PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

  • 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

  • Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

  • Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

  • Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

  • Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

  • Management experience

  • English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak?

Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap.

Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is

Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen.

Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is.

Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen.

Wat maakt deze functie anders?

Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat.

Je kunt rekenen op:

· Premium hooroplossingen

· Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant

· Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek

· Warme leads via onze partner Audibene

· Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie

· Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap

· De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak

· Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé

Voor wie is dit een mooie stap?

Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren.

Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen.

Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je.

Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes.

About MotherDuck

Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck, we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.

What you will do

The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next.

Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built.

This role is ideally based in Amsterdam or Berlin, but we are also open to great candidates remotely in Europe.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own major projects in our dual execution stack, so DuckDB can process queries seamlessly whether they're running locally or in the cloud.

  • Help build a cloud platform that dynamically assigns resources, so DuckDB stays efficient whether someone's running a tiny workload or pushing our biggest, highest-memory instances.

  • Lead cross-functional work with our frontend, platform, and infrastructure teams to keep the user experience coherent end to end.

  • Push the state of the art in embedded database performance, distributed execution, and DuckDB internals.

  • Deepen your DuckDB expertise and share it with the rest of the company through mentorship and documentation.

  • Work directly with our support team to debug issues, learn from real usage patterns, and prioritize the improvements that matter most.

  • Improve systems holistically... spotting architectural challenges early and clearing bottlenecks before they become problems.

  • Mentor teammates and help raise the bar for engineering practices across the team.

  • Work closely with DuckDB Labs (which grew out of the Database Architectures group at CWI, where vectorized execution and DuckDB were born) to help align on APIs and shape where DuckDB goes next.

What you bring

  • You've built and shipped complex backend systems, and you know what great looks like.

  • You're fluent in a backend language like C++, Rust, Java, or similar systems languages, and you're comfortable working close to the metal. (C++ and Rust are the biggest plus here, and we love a great Java engineer too.)

  • A good foundation in query engines, execution plans, indexing, and performance optimization techniques.

  • Hands-on experience with DuckDB is a huge plus, no matter what level you're coming in at.

  • You've worked with cloud infrastructure, networking, and building low-latency distributed systems.

  • You can scope and lead projects that span multiple collaborators and cross-functional dependencies.

  • You take pride in clear thinking, careful design, and thoughtful tradeoffs.

  • You're comfortable mentoring peers and helping build a collaborative, high-agency environment.

  • You enjoy engaging with the wider community, whether that's open-source conversations or working directly with DuckDB Labs.

What we provide

  • The opportunity to participate and contribute to DuckDB, one of most popular modern open source analytical databases.

  • Competitive salary and stock options so you have a stake in our flock’s success.

  • Flexible time off – take the time you need to recharge, explore, or just have a lazy day by the pond.

  • A good pension plan

  • Legendary company events – we bring the whole flock together once a year for unforgettable team gatherings a year to keep our bonds strong.

  • Hybrid work environment – Spend three days a week in the office collaborating with the flock, and work from wherever you’re most productive the rest of the time—whether that’s your home office, a coffee shop, or a peaceful lakeside retreat. We have to warn you though, most of us like the office so much we come anyway. It’s on the river Ij, with a great lunch every day.

Background

Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice.

Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods.

Role summary:<\/strong><\/h1>

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.<\/p>

We\u2019re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist<\/strong> to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use.<\/p>

This role is focused on research<\/strong>, including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave<\/strong>, and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You\u2019ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants<\/strong> and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you\u2019ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects.<\/p>

We\u2019re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions.<\/p>

How you\u2019ll work<\/strong><\/p>

  • You\u2019ll collaborate with technical leads and academic\/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform.<\/p><\/li>

  • You\u2019ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence.<\/p><\/li>

  • You\u2019ll work closely with our wet lab, dry lab and software teams, and identify which data you need to generate from our robotic lab.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

    <\/p>

    Key responsibilities:<\/strong><\/h1>

    Hybrid bioprocess modelling<\/strong><\/p>

    • Develop hybrid mechanistic\/ML cell response models that predict fermentation outcomes (growth, titer, yield, productivity) from process and sensor data.<\/p><\/li>

    • Fuse time-series signals from process analytical technology (Raman, NIR, dielectric spectroscopy, dissolved oxygen, off-gas) with offline analytics.<\/p><\/li>

    • Build mechanistic backbones (e.g., kinetic\/ODE models, genome-scale metabolic models) that constrain learning and generate synthetic training data.<\/p><\/li>

    • Develop machine learning surrogate models for computationally costly mechanistic simulations.<\/p><\/li>

    • Quantify uncertainty so that models can be trusted in high-stakes production settings.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

      Transfer across organisms and scales<\/strong><\/p>

      • Design models that carry over from benchtop to pilot and production scale, and across various microbes including bacteria and yeast.<\/p><\/li>

      • Use transfer learning and representation learning to make good predictions for new strains and processes with little data.<\/p><\/li>

      • Develop scale-transferable reactor characterisations and predictive KPI models for scale-up.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

        Real-time Model-Predictive Control<\/strong><\/p>

        • Build the AI\/ML layer for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and reinforcement-learning-based feeding strategies to optimize titer, rate, and yield dynamically.<\/p><\/li>

        • Fuse real-time data from Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and soft sensors (e.g., Raman, NIR) into dynamic state estimators to drive closed-loop bioreactor actuators (feed, air, agitation).<\/p><\/li>

        • Prototype simpler, deployable steps along the way, such as deviation detection and operator alerts<\/p><\/li>

        • Design control frameworks to proactively resolve metabolic bottlenecks and robustly account for model uncertainty, batch-to-batch variability, and inherent bioprocess stochasticity.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

          <\/p>

          Qualifications:<\/h1>

          • PhD in machine learning, bioengineering, computational biology, or a related field, or<\/strong> a Master\u2019s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience.<\/p><\/li>

          • Strong research independence; ability to scope and execute novel scientific work from start to finish.<\/p><\/li>

          • Demonstrated evidence of research contributions, including (but not limited to): peer-reviewed journal or conference papers, conference attendance, open-source contributions.<\/p><\/li>

          • Strong Python and modern ML tooling (e.g., PyTorch\/JAX, scikit-learn).<\/p><\/li>

          • Hands-on experience building models of dynamical systems or time-series data, ideally combining mechanistic and data-driven approaches.<\/p><\/li>

          • Experience working with frontier coding models, including multi-agent orchestration.<\/p><\/li>

          • Clear written and verbal communication, including with non-ML partners.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

            <\/p>

            Nice-to-have:<\/h1>

            • Experience with bioprocess or fermentation data, ideally from bioreactors at more than one scale<\/p><\/li>

            • Experience with Raman, NIR, or other spectroscopic data and chemometrics (e.g., PLS)<\/p><\/li>

            • Background in model-predictive control, reinforcement learning, or optimal control<\/p><\/li>

            • Experience with transfer learning, domain adaptation, or representation learning on biological data<\/p><\/li>

            • Familiarity with genome-scale metabolic models or kinetic modelling<\/p><\/li>

            • Experience with Bayesian methods, uncertainty quantification, or design of experiments<\/p><\/li>

  • Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads.

  • Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management).

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex.

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • Have two roles:

  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

About the Role

Our client is looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst (Data) to join a high-performing data and analytics team on a contract basis. You will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical data teams, translating business needs into clear, well-defined data requirements, mappings and specifications that engineers, architects and analysts can build against.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable in a workshop with senior stakeholders and in a SQL editor profiling source data. You will shape data solutions end to end, from discovery and requirements through to testing and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with business and technical stakeholders to elicit, analyze and document data and reporting requirements
  • Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Perform source system analysis and data profiling using SQL to assess data quality, structure and completeness
  • Produce source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, business glossaries and data lineage documentation
  • Work closely with data engineers, data architects and BI developers to design and deliver data pipelines, data models and reports
  • Define and validate business rules, transformation logic and data quality checks
  • Support data migration, integration and data warehouse / Lakehouse initiatives
  • Plan and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including preparing test cases and validating outputs against requirements
  • Identify data gaps, risks and dependencies, and recommend practical solutions
  • Support data governance, metadata management and data privacy practices

Essential Skills and Experience

  • 7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with a strong focus on data, analytics or data platform projects
  • Strong SQL skills for querying, profiling, validating and reconciling data
  • Proven experience writing source-to-target mappings and data transformation specifications
  • Solid understanding of data warehousing, data modelling (dimensional, relational) and ETL / ELT concepts
  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms (for example Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks or Microsoft Fabric)
  • Experience gathering requirements for BI and reporting solutions (for example Power BI, Tableau or similar)
  • Strong knowledge of data quality, data governance and metadata management principles
  • Experience working in Agile / Scrum delivery environments
  • Excellent documentation skills, including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows and data models
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with data catalogue or governance tools (for example Microsoft Purview, Collibra or Alation)
  • Familiarity with transformation tools such as dbt, Azure Data Factory or similar orchestration tooling
  • Working knowledge of Python for data analysis
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence
  • Exposure to data migration programs or large-scale data platform modernisation
  • Industry experience in financial services, government, utilities, retail or similar data-rich sectors
  • Relevant certifications (for example CBAP, IIBA-CBDA, Azure Data Fundamentals or similar)

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a QA Tester / Test Engineer who will support Department of War (DoW) customers applications modernization and cloud migration program by performing comprehensive testing across Agile development cycles, DevSecOps pipelines, incremental deployments, and security compliance processes. This role ensures all software modules, database changes, integrations, and releases meet functional, security, performance, and compliance standards required by the customer and the DoW.

This position is 100% remote.

Key Responsibilities

User Story & Sprint-Level Testing

  • Develop and execute unit tests, regression tests, security tests, and acceptance tests for all user stories.
  • Managing RITM (Requirements Traceability Matrix) and writing required manual/automated test cases
  • Maintain documented testing tasks for each closed and deployed user story.
  • Validate user story functionality aligns with functional and technical requirements (including Zero Trust, RMF, audit logging).

Automated Testing & DevSecOps Pipeline Support

  • Build, run, and maintain automated tests within GitLab pipelines using customer approved tools including Selenium, JUnit, utPLSQL, Fortify SCA, Fortify WebInspect, LoadRunner.
  • Ensure automated testing gates (SAST/DAST/QA checks) are enforced prior to code promotion.

Integration & Incremental Deployment Testing

  • Support integration testing to ensure new modules work seamlessly with legacy DRAS components during Strangler Pattern migration.
  • Validate data flows, orchestration behavior, and module interactions during incremental deployments.

Release Testing

  • Perform release-level testing for combined deployments staged for production.
  • Ensure release testing follows the established Release Test Strategy and IMS timelines.

Security & Compliance Testing

  • Perform security testing, static/dynamic scans, Zero Trust validation, and vulnerability assessments.
  • Support Security Control Assessments (SCA/ED‑SCA), FISMA/FedRAMP testing requirements, and Zero Trust validation.

Database & Data Migration Testing

  • Validate data mapping accuracy between legacy DRAS systems and the consolidated DRAS‑M database. [
  • Test ETL data migration processes for correctness, completeness, and timing as tables and schemas evolve.

Performance Testing

  • Execute performance and load tests using LoadRunner and ensure system scalability.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Produce test plans, cases, scripts, logs, defect reports, and test metrics (e.g., defect density, escaped defects, velocity).
  • Provide testing evidence for ATO packages (SSP, BIA, SCA results, etc.)

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 years experience with a BS/BA degree or 3 years with a MS/MA degree.
  • US Citizenship.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust Clearance.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks such as Selenium, JUnit, and utPLSQL.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).
  • Knowledge of secure coding and security testing tools (Fortify, ACAS, WebInspect).
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools (LoadRunner).
  • Experience testing APIs, integrations, data migrations, and database-driven applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong background in Agile testing practices.
  • Working understanding of DevSecOps pipelines and automation.
  • Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity frameworks including RMF, Zero Trust, NIST SP 800‑53, FISMA, FedRAMP.
  • Experience supporting testing for federal systems subject to RMF/ATO.
  • Knowledge of mainframe-to-cloud migration, refactoring validation, or Strangler Pattern transition testing.
  • Experience working on financial or entitlement systems within DoD or federal agencies.

Overview

BerryDunn is seeking an OCM Senior Consultant to join our Medicaid Practice Group that will have an initial focus supporting our client in Puerto Rico as a Medicaid Enterprise System (MES) Organizational Change Management (OCM) Subject Matter Expert (SME). As part of our consulting team focused on State Medicaid Agency (SMA) clients, you will leverage your OCM expertise, along with project management and Medicaid knowledge to help Medicaid agencies improve the health and lives of individuals. BerryDunn is seeking an individual with experience in OCM, preferably in state government, health IT, and the Health and Human Services (HHS) industry. This individual will support, and at times lead, the identification, development, and implementation of OCM activities in support of the Medicaid Enterprise and it’s supporting people and processes. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated State HHS IT OCM, project management and Prosci® background with experience in Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) modules implementations.

This position can be remotely-based or in one of our offices in Portland, Maine, Charleston, West Virginia, San Juan, Puerto Rico, or Phoenix, Arizona. You will report to senior leaders in the MPG and will help clients nationally with your initial focus being on our client in Puerto Rico.

Travel Expectations: Approximately 25% of travel to client sites is anticipated in the future to support projects.

You Will

Provide OCM services to SMA clients as they transform their organization to align with MES strategy. As a trusted advisor, you will provide leadership and guidance for clients and internal project teams in the following areas:

  • Support the project lead in managing the work of the BerryDunn project team related to OCM activities
  • Assist in the development of project deliverables and artifacts such as plans, surveys, and assessments related to OCM activities
  • Build strong relationships with project stakeholders, including client contacts, project team members, vendor contacts, etc
  • Help manage and report on project status, progress, budget, schedule, quality, and resources
  • Facilitate and attend internal BerryDunn team meetings
  • Facilitate meetings with the client, team, and vendors to achieve project objectives
  • Help mentor and develop project team members
  • Assist in developing, reviewing, and/or discussing project deliverables
  • Document and escalate project action items, issues, risks, and/or decisions to BerryDunn leadership, the client, and other project stakeholders
  • Provide frequent, clear, and consistent communication to the client, team members, vendor, and direct reports

You Have

  • Bachelor’s degree (a bachelor’s degree can be replaced with an additional four (4) years related experience)
  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience implementing OCM practices for system implementation projects using an industry standard change management framework.
  • Three (3) years of demonstrated experience in an OCM lead or SME role supporting a SMA or a large healthcare provider management organization of a similar size
  • Demonstrated ability to confidently facilitate meetings and present complex concepts to stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to balance multiple assignments and achieve quality results in a timely manner
  • Demonstrated ability to create and sustain positive working relationships with diverse stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to perform and thrive in an ambiguous and changing environment
  • Written and verbal fluency in English
  • Proficiency in all Microsoft (MS) applications
  • Spanish fluency is a plus

The Chief Client Officer is responsible for leading the organization's client strategy, relationship management, and client success functions across all segments. The role focuses on driving long-term client value, satisfaction, retention, and growth by ensuring exceptional service delivery and deep, trusted client relationships. The CCO acts as the executive voice of the client within the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy & Relationship Management

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive client strategy aligned with business goals.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with key clients and strategic accounts.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for high-value client issues and engagements.

Client Growth & Retention

  • Drive client retention, loyalty, and expansion across portfolios.
  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing client base.
  • Develop strategies to increase client lifetime value (CLV).

Client Experience & Success

  • Ensure consistent delivery of high-quality client experience across all touchpoints.
  • Oversee client onboarding, engagement, and success management processes.
  • Implement frameworks to measure and improve client satisfaction (NPS, CSAT).

Account Management & Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee key account management teams and client delivery functions.
  • Ensure client expectations are met through effective service delivery.
  • Coordinate resolution of complex client issues with internal teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales, operations, product, marketing, and support teams.
  • Ensure client feedback is integrated into product development and service improvements.
  • Align internal teams around client needs and priorities.

Client Insights & Analytics

  • Analyze client behavior, feedback, and performance data.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to improve client engagement and satisfaction.
  • Provide actionable insights to executive leadership.

Business Development Support

  • Support sales teams in acquiring high-value clients and strategic accounts.
  • Participate in client pitches, presentations, and negotiations.
  • Strengthen executive-level client relationships during pre- and post-sales cycles.

Governance & Reporting

  • Establish KPIs for client success, retention, and growth.
  • Provide regular reports and updates to CEO and executive leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and contractual obligations.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and mentor client success, account management, and service teams.
  • Build a client-centric culture across the organization.
  • Drive continuous training and professional development initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, or related field; MBA preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in client management, account management, customer success, or senior leadership roles.
  • Proven track record of managing enterprise or high-value client relationships.
  • Strong experience in service delivery, relationship management, or client success leadership.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Strong strategic and commercial thinking.
  • Customer-centric leadership mindset.
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and influence skills.
  • Executive presence and stakeholder management.

Performance Metrics

  • Client retention and churn rate.
  • Client satisfaction (CSAT) and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
  • Revenue growth from existing clients.
  • Success of key account management initiatives.
  • SLA adherence and service quality performance.

Descripción

PROGRAMADOR/A CAM | MOLDES INDUSTRIALES | REMOTO

En ACIERTA HEADHUNTER lideramos esta búsqueda para una compañía líder del sector industrial.

¿Te apasiona la programación CAM y quieres participar en proyectos de mecanizado de alto nivel técnico, trabajando con moldes industriales y procesos de precisión?

Buscamos un/a Programador/a CAM con experiencia en programación de trayectorias para centros CNC, que quiera aportar su conocimiento en un entorno especializado, técnico e innovador. Esta posición tendrá un papel clave en la optimización de procesos de mecanizado, la calidad de las piezas y la articulación con equipos de diseño e ingeniería en proyectos de alto valor técnico.

Es una oportunidad ideal para perfiles que disfrutan resolver retos reales de fabricación, proponer mejoras y trabajar con autonomía, precisión y criterio técnico en una operación enfocada en excelencia.

Requisitos

FORMACIÓN ACADÉMICA
Formación técnica, tecnóloga o profesional en Fabricación Mecánica, Ingeniería Mecánica, Ingeniería Industrial o áreas afines.
Se valora formación complementaria en programación CAM o mecanizado CNC.
Conocimientos de Excel y Power BI son importantes.

EXPERIENCIA & CONOCIMIENTOS
Experiencia mínima de 2 años como Programador/a CAM en entornos industriales.
Manejo de software CAM, preferiblemente PowerMill.
Se valoran conocimientos en NX, Mastercam, Tebis u otros sistemas similares.
Experiencia en centros de mecanizado CNC de 3 y 5 ejes.
Capacidad para interpretar planos técnicos y modelos sólidos en 3D.
Conocimiento de procesos de mecanizado de precisión, idealmente en fabricación de moldes o piezas complejas.
Se valoran conocimientos en controles FANUC, SIEMENS y HEIDENHAIN.
Inglés y/o francés técnico será un plus.

RESPONSABILIDADES CLAVE
Programar trayectorias de mecanizado para centros CNC mediante software CAM.
Analizar planos técnicos y modelos 3D para asegurar una programación precisa y eficiente.
Definir herramientas, estrategias de corte y parámetros que optimicen tiempos y calidad.
Acompañar técnicamente la fabricación de piezas y resolver incidencias del proceso.
Proponer mejoras que aumenten la eficiencia productiva y reduzcan tiempos de ciclo.
Trabajar de forma articulada con los equipos de CAD, ingeniería y taller para garantizar el resultado final.

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES

Programar, validar y ajustar trayectorias de mecanizado según requerimientos del proyecto.
Dar seguimiento técnico a la fabricación de piezas complejas y moldes industriales.
Brindar soporte a operarios y personal de taller frente a dudas o ajustes del proceso.
Identificar oportunidades de mejora en programación, tiempos y uso de materiales.
Asegurar estándares de calidad dimensional y funcional en cada proceso.
Apoyar la documentación técnica básica cuando aplique.

COMPETENCIAS CLAVE
Precisión técnica y enfoque en calidad: fundamentales para trabajar con piezas de alto nivel de exigencia.
Capacidad analítica: para evaluar trayectorias, procesos y oportunidades de optimización.
Resolución de problemas: clave para ajustar programas y responder a retos reales de fabricación.
Autonomía y proactividad: importantes en una posición con alto componente técnico y de mejora continua.
Trabajo colaborativo: para integrarse con diseño, ingeniería y taller de manera efectiva.
Comunicación clara y ordenada: necesaria para alinear criterios técnicos y operativos.

Beneficios

OPORTUNIDAD & BENEFICIOS
Posición remota, ideal para perfiles técnicos que buscan flexibilidad y autonomía.
Participación en proyectos industriales complejos, retadores y de alto nivel técnico.
Vinculación a un equipo especializado en moldes industriales y mecanizado de precisión.
Entorno colaborativo, innovador y orientado a la excelencia operativa.
Oportunidad de crecimiento y desarrollo en una operación con foco técnico real.

Si tienes experiencia en programación CAM, disfrutas los entornos técnicos exigentes y te motiva participar en proyectos donde tu criterio realmente impacta el resultado final, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

Postúlate y conecta tu experiencia con un rol donde la precisión, la mejora continua y la ingeniería aplicada hacen la diferencia.

En procesos como este, el primer filtro es técnico. El segundo es narrativo.


Ubicación

Colombia | CO,Bogotá, D.C. - Bogotá, D. C. | 11001

      <title>Askable: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract) </title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6591/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Australia 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.askablelabs.com/">https://www.askablelabs.com/</a>
</p>

<p>We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.</p>
<p>You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.</p>
<p>Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.</p>
<p><strong>How it works</strong></p>
<ol class="iiilu2 iiil4m iiimkb">
<li><strong>Apply. </strong>Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.</li>
<li><strong>Propose.</strong> Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.</li>
<li><strong>Build.</strong> In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.</li>
<li><strong>Stress-test. </strong>Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.</li>
<li><strong>Model testing.</strong> Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.</li>
<li><strong>Review.</strong> A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.</li>
<li><strong>Next task.</strong> Once your task is accepted, start another.</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Requirements</strong></p>
<ul class="iiilu2 iiil4n iiimkb">
<li>2+ years of professional software engineering</li>
<li>Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)</li>
<li>Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++</li>
<li>Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing</li>
<li>Regular use of an AI coding tool</li>
<li>Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models</li>
<li>You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words</li>
<li>At least 10 hours a week, starting now</li>
<li>A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p>
<ul class="iiilu2 iiil4n iiimkb">
<li>Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure</li>
<li>Experience building agent tasks or RL environments</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Terms</strong></p>
<ul class="iiilu2 iiil4n iiimkb">
<li>US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you</li>
<li>Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms</li>
<li>The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us</li>
<li>Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork</li>
</ul>
<p>Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/askable-software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-contract">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/askable-software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-contract</a></p>
</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6586/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> London
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://www.medify.co.uk">http://www.medify.co.uk</a>
</p>

<p>Remote | Full-Time | UK&nbsp;<br><br></p>
<p>About Us</p>
<p>At Medify, we’re on a mission to widen access to medicine and healthcare careers through world-class digital learning experiences. Since 2009, we’ve helped thousands of students prepare for high-stakes admissions tests, and we’re continuing to invest in our technology to build innovative, scalable products that support learners around the world.</p>
<p>As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead, mentor and develop our engineering team while remaining hands-on in building the platform that powers Medify.<br><br></p>
<p>The Role</p>
<p>As an Engineering Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping both our engineering culture and technical direction. Working closely with the CTO, Product and Design teams, you’ll lead a team of talented full-stack engineers, helping them grow while ensuring we continue to deliver high-quality software that delights our users.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on leadership role, with at least 50% of your time dedicated to engineering. You’ll contribute across the full software development lifecycle - from architecture and design through to development, testing and deployment - while driving engineering excellence and fostering a collaborative, high-performing team.</p>
<p>Our current technology stack includes Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL, with infrastructure transitioning from Heroku to AWS.<br><br></p>
<p>Key Responsibilities</p>
<ul>
<li>Lead, mentor and support a team of full-stack engineers through coaching, regular 1:1s and performance reviews.</li>
<li>Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.</li>
<li>Support career development, engagement and long-term capability building across the engineering team.</li>
<li>Contribute to hiring by supporting interviews and recruitment of exceptional engineering talent.</li>
<li>Design, develop and maintain scalable, high-quality software solutions.</li>
<li>Collaborate closely with Product and Design teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.</li>
<li>Participate in architectural decisions and help shape the future of the Medify platform.</li>
<li>Conduct thoughtful code reviews and promote engineering best practices.</li>
<li>Troubleshoot and resolve software issues while maintaining high standards of reliability and performance.</li>
<li>Develop automated tests and contribute to a robust testing culture.</li>
<li>Participate in agile planning, backlog refinement and sprint delivery.</li>
<li>Stay up to date with emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve our engineering practices.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>About You</p>
<p>You’ll be a technically strong engineering leader who enjoys developing people just as much as building great software. You’re comfortable balancing strategic leadership with hands-on development and thrive in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.</p>
<p>You’ll ideally have:</p>
<ul>
<li>2+ years’ experience leading or managing software engineering teams.</li>
<li>5+ years’ experience in software development.</li>
<li>Strong experience with modern software engineering practices and frameworks.</li>
<li>Experience with Ruby on Rails and React (highly desirable).</li>
<li>A proven track record of building scalable, maintainable software.</li>
<li>Experience working in Agile development environments.</li>
<li>Experience collaborating with cross-functional Product and Design teams.</li>
<li>Experience recruiting, mentoring and developing engineers.</li>
<li>Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.</li>
<li>Excellent problem-solving ability with a focus on quality and continuous improvement.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>Qualifications</p>
<ul>
<li>Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline is desirable, but not essential.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>Technical Skills</p>
<ul>
<li>Strong knowledge of modern programming languages and software frameworks.</li>
<li>Excellent understanding of software architecture, design principles, data structures and algorithms.</li>
<li>Experience working with relational databases, APIs and networking.</li>
<li>Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and software quality practices.</li>
<li>Familiarity with DevOps tools and deployment pipelines.</li>
<li>Ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies.</li>
<li>Excellent collaboration and communication skills.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>✅ What We Offer</p>
<ul>
<li>Fully remote working with flexibility and autonomy.</li>
<li>The opportunity to shape the future of Medify’s technology platform.</li>
<li>A supportive, collaborative engineering culture that values continuous learning.</li>
<li>A hands-on leadership role with real technical influence.</li>
<li>The opportunity to work on products that positively impact thousands of aspiring healthcare professionals every year.</li>
<li>Competitive salary and benefits package.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>How to Apply</p>
<p>If you’re passionate about building exceptional software, developing high-performing engineering teams and making a meaningful impact in education, we’d love to hear from you.</p>
<p>Submit your application along with your CV using the link attached.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/medify-engineering-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/medify-engineering-manager</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Lattice: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure Platform</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - Canada
</p>

<h2><strong>This is Engineering at Lattice</strong></h2>
<p>Lattice’s Engineering team is continuously working to better both our product and our craft. We use a modern, cutting-edge tech stack and love experimenting with new technologies. We strive for maintainable, robust, and performant code. We’re highly collaborative and continuously iterative, and work closely with designers and product managers. We prioritize not only great technical architecture but also an amazing product experience.</p>
<p>The Infrastructure Platform team focuses on the cloud services, infrastructure, and internal platforms that power Lattice’s products. We build reliable, scalable pathways that make it easier for product engineers to develop, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot their services.&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>What You Will Do</strong></h2>
<p>As a Senior Software Engineer on the Infrastructure Platform team, you will work across a broad technical footprint, including AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes, distributed systems, observability, deployment tooling, and internal developer platforms.</p>
<p>You will use your prior experience to understand how systems and services interact, identify gaps or sources of friction, and build platform capabilities that improve reliability and developer productivity.</p>
<ul>
<li>Design, build, and operate AWS-based cloud infrastructure and platform services.</li>
<li>Create reusable internal platform capabilities that improve how engineers build, deploy, and operate services.</li>
<li>Work across AWS, Kubernetes, IaC, CI/CD, observability, and distributed systems.</li>
<li>Partner with product engineering to identify recurring needs and turn them into scalable platform solutions.</li>
<li>Evaluate system interactions, identify risks or inefficiencies, and drive improvements.</li>
<li>Improve reliability, performance, availability, and maintainability of production systems.</li>
<li>Define and promote platform practices (SLOs, monitoring, incident response, operational readiness).</li>
<li>Instrument, debug, and improve services and infrastructure (including TypeScript services).</li>
<li>Lead technical initiatives from problem definition through delivery and adoption.</li>
<li>Communicate tradeoffs, risks, and progress to engineering stakeholders.</li>
<li>Mentor engineers on building reliable, scalable systems.</li>
<li>Participate in on-call and incident response.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What You Will Bring to the Table</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of software or infrastructure engineering experience.</li>
<li>Deep AWS experience in production environments.</li>
<li>Experience with cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and system design.</li>
<li>Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, or shared services.</li>
<li>Hands-on Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform a plus).</li>
<li>Strong programming skills and ability to debug production systems (TypeScript a plus).</li>
<li>Experience with CI/CD and automated deployment workflows.</li>
<li>Experience with observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, SLOs).</li>
<li>Ability to reason across complex systems and understand cross-component interactions.</li>
<li>Experience leading technical initiatives with multiple stakeholders.</li>
<li>Strong communication skills and collaborative mindset.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Location Requirement:</strong><br>This role is open to candidates located in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada. At this time, we are only able to hire employees residing in these provinces.</p>
<p>____</p>
<p><em>The estimated annual cash salary for this role is CAD $123,750 - CAD $165,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans.</em></p>
<p><em>Benefits: The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical insurance; Dental insurance; Life, AD&amp;D, and Disability Insurance; Natural Disaster Support Program; Wellness Apps; Paid Parental Leave, Paid Time off inclusive of holidays and sick time; One time WFH Office Set-Up Stipend; Retirement Plan; Financial Planning; and Learning &amp; Development Budget.</em></p>
<p><em>Note on Pay Transparency:</em><br><em>Lattice provides an estimate of the compensation for roles that may be hired as required by regulations. Compensation may vary based on (a) location, as Lattice factors in specific location when benchmarking compensation for most roles; (b) individual candidate skills and qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience. </em><em>Additionally, Lattice leverages current market data to determine compensation, so posted compensation figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Lattice reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.</em></p>
<p><em>Lattice welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process.</em></p>
<p><em>#LI-Remote</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>About Lattice</strong></h2>
<p><span>Lattice is on a mission to build cultures where employees and their companies thrive. In an age where employees have more choices than ever before, businesses that put employees first are winning – and Lattice is building the tools to empower those people-centric companies. </span></p>
<p><span>Lattice is a people success platform that offers performance reviews, employee engagement surveys, real-time feedback, weekly check-ins, goal setting, and career planning in a way that allows companies to focus on employee development, growth, and engagement – yielding stronger employee retention, performance, and impact to the bottom line . Since launching in 2016, we have grown to over 5,000+ customers globally, including brands like Loom, Robinhood, and Gusto.</span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<hr>

      <title>StockX: Category Manager - Apparel</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, USA
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.</strong></p></div><h3><strong>Why you’ll love this role:</strong></h3>
<p>StockX is the world’s leading marketplace for current culture, built at the intersection of commerce, community, and credibility. Apparel is foundational to StockX — not just as a category, but as an expression of identity, culture, and global trends.</p>
<p>We are expanding how apparel culture shows up on StockX through creator-driven, community-oriented commerce experiences that blend storytelling, expertise, and transaction. To do this well, we need category leaders who don’t just understand the apparel market — they live inside it.</p>
<p>The Apparel Category Manager is the single-threaded owner of apparel category growth within a new, high-priority commerce initiative. This person is the in-house expert on Fashion &amp; Apparel culture, people, economics, and moments — and is responsible for translating that expertise into supply growth, engagement, and GMV.</p>
<p>You will act as:</p>
<ul>
<li>The internal authority on the first-hand and second-hand apparel ecosystem</li>
<li>The external face of StockX to apparel sellers, creators, designers, and community leaders</li>
<li>The architect of the apparel go-to-market playbook for this new initiative</li>
</ul>
<p>This role blends deep cultural fluency, strategic ownership, and hands-on execution. Early on, you will own everything related to apparel within this initiative. As the category scales, you will grow into a leader overseeing a broader apparel portfolio and team.</p>
<h3><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h3>
<h4><strong>Own the Apparel Category End-to-End</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Define and execute the growth strategy for apparel within the platform</li>
<li>Own category-level performance across supply, engagement, and revenue</li>
<li>Establish quarterly goals, leading indicators, and operating rhythms</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Be the Market &amp; Culture Expert</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Maintain deep, current knowledge of apparel culture, including:</li>
<ul>
<li>Key sellers, creators, designers, brands, and retailers</li>
<li>Sub-segments (streetwear, luxury, contemporary, vintage, performance, regional styles, etc.)</li>
<li>Seasonal drops, brand dynamics, collaborations, and cultural moments</li>
<li>Pricing dynamics, liquidity, and resale economics</li>
</ul>
<li>Serve as the internal voice of the apparel community, informing product, marketing, and platform decisions</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Supply &amp; Creator Acquisition</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Build and own a pipeline of high-impact apparel sellers, shops, designers, influencers, brands, and creators</li>
<li>Personally recruit and onboard flagship sellers who set the tone for the platform</li>
<li>Develop seller strategies that balance credibility, storytelling, and commerce</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Commerce Strategy &amp; Category Moments</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Identify and orchestrate Fashion &amp; Apparel-specific moments, campaigns, and formats that drive engagement and conversion</li>
<li>Partner with Category Marketing to design culturally authentic activations</li>
<li>Experiment with new approaches and iterate quickly based on performance and feedback</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Work closely with Account and Partnerships Managers to scale seller acquisition and support</li>
<li>Collaborate with Product and Engineering to shape features and tools that matter to category sellers and buyers</li>
<li>Provide clear, actionable insights from the market to influence roadmap prioritization</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Build the Playbook</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Document learnings, frameworks, and best practices that can be reused across future categories</li>
<li>Help define what “great” looks like for category ownership at StockX</li>
<li>Support hiring and onboarding as the apparel category team grows</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>About you:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Deeply embedded in second-hand fashion &amp; apparel culture — you know the people, platforms, trends, and economics, and you’re already plugged into the ecosystem</li>
<li>5+ years of experience in category management, partnerships, marketplace growth, brand, or operator roles in apparel, streetwear, fashion, or adjacent ecosystems</li>
<li>Comfortable owning outcomes, not just strategy — you execute, iterate, and adapt</li>
<li>Strong relationship builder with credibility among sellers, creators, designers, and community members</li>
<li>Data-literate and commercially minded — you understand pricing, margins, liquidity, and incentives</li>
<li>Entrepreneurial, scrappy, and energized by building something from the ground up</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Existing network of apparel resellers, brand operators, designers, boutiques, or creators</li>
<li>Experience buying and selling apparel or operating within resale or fashion marketplaces</li>
<li>Familiarity with content-driven commerce, creator platforms, or enthusiast communities</li>
<li>Experience working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams</li>
<li>Experience running your own business or startup</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Why This Role Matters:</strong></h3>
<p>Apparel will define the early perception and success of this new commerce initiative at StockX. This role sets:</p>
<ul>
<li>The cultural bar for the platform</li>
<li>The go-to-market blueprint for future categories</li>
<li>The credibility of StockX with the apparel community</li>
</ul>
<p>You will have outsized influence on how StockX expands its leadership from marketplace into deeper cultural engagement.</p>
<div><em>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.</em></div>
<div><em>&nbsp;</em></div>
<div><em>Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $120,000 to $130,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary.&nbsp;</em></div><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="job-preview__description ">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="job-preview__description "><strong>About StockX</strong></div>
<div class="job-preview__description "><strong><br></strong>StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com.</div>

      <title>Upgrade: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Canada (Remote)
</p>

<p><span><strong>About the Role:</strong><br><br>An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.</span></p>
<p><span>We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. </span><span>You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.</span></p>
<p><span>Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>Our Core Technologies</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>What You'll Do</strong></span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Journey creation:</strong> Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Optimization:</strong> Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Edge case handling: </strong>Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Containment:</strong> Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Product partnership:</strong> Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Safety and compliance:</strong> Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Handoffs:</strong> Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Testing:</strong> Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Monitoring: </strong>Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Voice tuning:</strong> Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Sierra relationship: </strong>Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>What We Look For:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles</span></p>
<p><span>• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails</span></p>
<p><span>• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates</span></p>
<p><span>• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes</span></p>
<p><span>• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.</span></p>
<p><span>• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved</span></p>
<p><span>• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response</span></p>
<p><span>• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>Nice To Have:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)</span></p>
<p><span>• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling</span></p>
<p><span>• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design</span></p>
<p><span>• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)</span></p>
<p><span>• Conversation design or UX writing experience</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>What We Offer You:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<p><span>• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan</span></p>
<p><span>• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>• Flexible PTO</span></p>
<p><span>• Opportunities for professional growth and development<br>• Paid parental leave</span></p>
<p><span>• Health &amp; wellness initiatives</span></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-ai-experience-engineer-conversational-ai">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-ai-experience-engineer-conversational-ai</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Databricks: Deployment Strategist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - India
</p>

<h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2>
<p>The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering <em>outcomes</em>, not just a platform.</p>
<p>You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."</p>
<h2><strong>Role Description</strong></h2>
<p>As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.</p>
<p>You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.</p>
<p>This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.</p>
<h2><strong>The impact you will have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>C-Suite Scoping &amp; Value Definition:</strong> Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.</li>
<li><strong>End-to-End Product Ownership:</strong> Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.</li>
<li><strong>Technical Solution Leadership</strong><strong> &amp; Delivery:</strong> Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.</li>
<li><strong>Solution Launch &amp; Landing:</strong> Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic Handoff &amp; Growth:</strong> Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What we look for</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Executive Presence &amp; Communication:</strong> You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.</li>
<li><strong>Product Judgment &amp; Delivery:</strong> You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.</li>
<li><strong>Technical Fluency &amp; Architecture Judgment:</strong> You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on Technical Ability:</strong> You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.</li>
<li><strong>Relevant Experience:</strong> Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p>
<p><span>Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p>
<p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p>
<p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p>
